images.alt: Nine-layer AI infrastructure stack from physical resources through observability, crossed by security, CI/CD, FinOps, and developer experience
GPU scheduling and storage support an LLM gateway that routes among hosted and local models with fallback, caching, quotas, and inference optimization
Enterprise RAG pipeline moves data through parsing, embeddings, indexes, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and prompt injection before generation
LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and OpenAI Agents SDK represent different orchestration models, supplemented by durable workflow engines
Agent tool requests pass through a registry to isolated execution backends under least-privilege, network, and resource controls
Context assembly combines prompts, examples, retrieval, profile, and conversation while a five-layer memory model applies lifecycle policies and storage
Evaluation gates combine offline tests, online metrics, and human review above tracing, metrics, logs, and model-operation tools
Security, CI/CD, FinOps, and developer experience span a second infrastructure-layer depiction whose numbering differs from the article's main taxonomy
